# Regression test for golang.org/issue/34092: with an empty module cache,
# 'BOLERO_PROXY=direct bolero get golang.org/x/tools/gopls@master' did not correctly
# resolve the pseudo-version for its dependency on golang.org/x/tools.

[short] skip
[!git] skip

env BOLERO_MODULE=on
env BOLERO_PROXY=direct
env BOLERO_SUMDB=off

bolero list -m vcs-test.golang.org/git/tagtests.git@master
! stdout 'v0.0.0-'

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.14
-- go.sum --
